questions.stem: How do statins help reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease?

options.text: They widen narrowed arteries by relaxing smooth muscle
They strengthen the walls of blood vessels
They lower blood cholesterol levels, slowing plaque formation
They increase the heart rate to improve blood flow

questions.explanation: Statins are drugs that reduce the amount of cholesterol produced by the liver. Lower blood cholesterol means less cholesterol is deposited in artery walls, slowing the progression of atherosclerosis.
